title: Trauma endures in Paris suburb after police grenade shatters teenager's jaw
subhead: On September 28, 14-year-old Eden suffered a fractured jaw and lost most of his teeth after he was struck in the face by a tear-gas grenade fired at close range, just a few meters from his high school, where a protest was taking place. Students, teachers and parents spoke of their fear, anger and sense of helplessness.

title: Swann Arlaud did not want to talk politics
subhead: At 45, Swann Arlaud has remained true to his deeply held left-wing convictions. In May, he risked his career by signing an open letter against the billionaire Vincent Bolloré, who owns French cinema's largest funder. The actor stars as a zealous collaborationist civil servant of the Vichy regime in the newly released 'A Man of His Time.'
